pages.title: The Harbinger
pages.text: $(bold)Cataclysm's end: the Harbinger's witherite and wither cannon, the Ender Guardian's void arms and enderite, Maledictus's cursium, soul render and annihilator, and the frozen draugr halls.$(br2)$(thing)Flight$(n), ring 12.$(br)$(thing)70 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Ignis.

pages.title: Task
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)Kill the Harbinger$(n)$(br2)Pays 12 Focal Shards once. Counts only once this node is reachable.
